met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Ganganagar, Delhi, Lucknow, Ranchi, Digha and thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Punjab & adjoining Pakistan now lies over Punjab & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood now lies over Southeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Jharkhand and adjoining Bihar extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has merged with the above system.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood persists and now seen between 4.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulationover North Coastal Andhra Pradesh & adjoining South Chhattisgarh now lies over south Chhattisgarh & adjoining Telangana at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central Assam & adjoining Nagaland between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining Coastal Andhra Pradesh between 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea level.
The trough from North Bihar to Northwest Bay of Bengal across Jharkhand and Gangetic west Bengal between 1.5 & 3.1 Km above mean sea level has become less marked.
